column1: ‘I am from a large, poor family and for many years we have done without breakfast.
column2: “我家人口多，又很穷，多年来我们都吃不上早饭。

column1: Ever since I joined the Street Kids International program I have been able to buy my family sugar and buns for breakfast.
column2: 自从参加了国际街头儿童组织的项目，我就有钱给家人买糖和小面包当早饭了。
column6: have been able to|已经能够

column1: I have also bought myself decent second-hand clothes and shoes.’
column2: 我还给自己买了像样的二手衣服和鞋子。”
column6: clothes and shoes|n. 衣服和鞋子

column1: ‘We’ve had business experience.
column2: “我们已经有了做生意的经验。

column1: Now I’m confident to expand what we’ve been doing.
column2: 现在，我有信心把眼下的生意做大。
column5: what we’ve been doing|我们一直在做的事

column1: I’ve learnt cash management, and the way of keeping money so we save for re-investment.
column2: 我学会了管理现金，也学会了怎样把钱留存下来，用来再投资。

column1: Now business is a part of our lives.
column2: 现在，做生意已经成了我们生活的一部分。

column1: As well, we didn’t know each other before – now we’ve made new friends.’

column1: Participants in the Youth Skills Enterprise Initiative Program, Zambia
column2: 赞比亚青年创业技能项目的参与者

column1: Although small-scale business training and credit programs have become more common throughout the world, relatively little attention has been paid to the need to direct such opportunities to young people.
column2: 尽管针对小生意的经营培训和信贷项目在世界各地日渐普遍，人们却较少关注一个问题：有必要把这样的机会提供给年轻人。

column1: Even less attention has been paid to children living on the streets or in difficult circumstances.
column2: 对生活在街头或处境艰难的儿童，人们的关注就更少了。
column3: Even less attention|n. 更少的关注
column4: living on the streets|生活在街头

column1: Over the past nine years, Street Kids International (S.K.I.) has been working with partner organisations in Africa, Latin America and India to support the economic lives of street children.
column2: 在过去九年里，国际街头儿童组织（S.K.I.）一直与非洲、拉丁美洲和印度的伙伴机构合作，帮助街头儿童谋生。
column3: Over the past nine years|过去九年来

column1: The purpose of this paper is to share some of the lessons S.K.I. and our partners have learned.
column2: 本文旨在分享我们国际街头儿童组织和合作伙伴积累的一些经验。

column1: Typically, children do not end up on the streets due to a single cause, but to a combination of factors: a dearth of adequately funded schools, the demand for income at home, family breakdown and violence.
column2: 孩子流落街头通常有多种原因，例如经费充足的学校太少、家里需要收入、家庭破裂以及暴力。
column4: end up on the streets|最终流落街头
column6: a combination of factors|n. 多种因素共同作用
column9: demand for income|n. 对收入的需要

column1: The street may be attractive to children as a place to find adventurous play and money.
column2: 这条街道对孩子们来说可能很有吸引力，因为他们可以在这里找到冒险玩耍的机会，同时也能获得一些金钱。

column1: However, it is also a place where some children are exposed, with little or no protection, to exploitative employment, urban crime, and abuse.
column2: 然而，一些孩子在此处缺乏保护，暴露于剥削性工作、城市犯罪和虐待之中。

column1: Children who work on the streets are generally involved in unskilled, labour-intensive tasks which require long hours, such as shining shoes, carrying goods, guarding or washing cars, and informal trading.
column2: 在街头工作的儿童通常从事需要长时间、缺乏技能的体力劳动，如擦鞋、搬运货物、看守或洗车，以及非正式的买卖活动。

column1: Some may also earn income through begging, or through theft and other illegal activities.
column2: 有些人则通过乞讨、盗窃以及其他非法活动来赚取收入。

column1: At the same time, there are street children who take pride in supporting themselves and their families and who often enjoy their work.
column2: 同时，有些街头儿童以能够自立并养活家人为荣，且通常享受自己的工作。

column1: Many children may choose entrepreneurship because it allows them a degree of independence, is less exploitative than many forms of paid employment, and is flexible enough to allow them to participate in other activities such as education and domestic tasks.
column2: 许多孩子可能选择自己做生意，因为这样既有一定的自主性，又比许多受雇工作少受剥削，时间也更灵活，还能上学、做家务。
column7: paid employment|n. 受雇有偿工作

column1: S.K.I. has worked with partner organisations in Latin America, Africa and India to develop innovative opportunities for street children to earn income.
column2: 国际街头儿童组织与拉丁美洲、非洲和印度的伙伴机构合作，为街头儿童开辟新的谋生途径。

column1: The S.K.I. Bicycle Courier Service first started in the Sudan.
column2: S.K.I.自行车快递服务最初是在苏丹开始的。

column1: Participants in this enterprise were supplied with bicycles, which they used to deliver parcels and messages, and which they were required to pay for gradually from their wages.
column2: 参加这个项目的人领到自行车，用来递送包裹和消息，车款则须从他们的工资中分期偿还。

column1: A similar program was taken up in Bangalore, India.
column2: 在印度班加罗尔也实施了一个类似的计划。

column1: Another successful project, the Shoe Shine Collective, was a partnership program with the Y.W.C.A. in the Dominican Republic.
column2: 另一个成功的项目是‘擦鞋小组’，这是一个与多米尼加共和国的Y.W.C.A.合作的合作项目。

column1: In this project, participants were lent money to purchase shoe shine boxes.
column2: 在这个项目中，参与者获得了资金，用于购买擦鞋箱。

column1: They were also given a safe place to store their equipment, and facilities for individual savings plans.
column2: 他们还获得了存放设备的安全场所，以及用于个人储蓄计划的设施。

column1: The Youth Skills Enterprise Initiative in Zambia is a joint program with the Red Cross Society and the Y.W.C.A.
column2: 赞比亚的‘青年技能创业计划’是由红十字会和Y.W.C.A联合发起的一项项目。

column1: Street youths are supported to start their own small business through business training, life skills training and access to credit.
column2: 生活在街头的青年可通过商业培训、生活技能训练以及获得信贷支持来开始自己的小生意。

column1: The following lessons have emerged from the programs that S.K.I. and partner organisations have created.
column2: 以下经验来自国际街头儿童组织与伙伴机构开办的项目。

column1: Being an entrepreneur is not for everyone, nor for every street child.
column2: 创业并不适合所有人，也不适合每一个街头儿童。

column1: Ideally, potential participants will have been involved in the organisation’s programs for at least six months, and trust and relationship building will have already been established.
column2: 理想情况下，潜在参与者应已参与组织的项目至少六个月，并且已建立起信任关系。

column1: The involvement of the participants has been essential to the development of relevant programs.
column2: 参与者的参与对于相关项目的成功实施至关重要。

column1: When children have had a major role in determining procedures, they are more likely to abide by and enforce them.
column2: 当孩子们在决策过程中扮演了重要角色之后，他们更有可能遵守并执行这些规则。

column1: It is critical for all loans to be linked to training programs that include the development of basic business and life skills.
column2: 所有贷款都必须与包含基本商业和生活技能培养的培训项目相联系。

column1: There are tremendous advantages to involving parents or guardians in the program, where such relationships exist.
column2: 在存在这种关系的家庭中，让父母或监护人参与该计划会带来巨大的好处。

column1: Home visits allow staff the opportunity to know where the participants live, and to understand more about each individual’s situation.
column2: 家访让工作人员有机会了解参与者的居住情况，从而更深入地了解每个人的状况。

column1: Small loans are provided initially for purchasing fixed assets such as bicycles, shoe shine kits and basic building materials for a market stall.
column2: 这些小额贷款最初用于购买固定资产，比如自行车、修理工具包以及经营摊位所需的建筑材料。

column1: As the entrepreneurs gain experience, the enterprises can be gradually expanded and consideration can be given to increasing loan amounts.
column2: 随着企业家们积累更多经验，这些企业就可以逐步扩大规模，同时也可以考虑增加贷款额度。

column1: The loan amounts in S.K.I. programs have generally ranged from US$30-$100.
column2: 在S.K.I.项目中，贷款的金额通常介于30美元到100美元之间。

column1: All S.K.I. programs have charged interest on the loans, primarily to get the entrepreneurs used to the concept of paying interest on borrowed money.
column2: 所有S.K.I.项目都对贷款收取利息，主要是为了让创业者习惯于偿还借入资金的利息。

column1: Generally the rates have been modest (lower than bank rates).
column2: 一般来说，这些利率都相当低（低于银行的利率）

column1: There is a need to recognise the importance of access to credit for impoverished young people seeking to fulfil economic needs.
column2: 我们需要认识到，对于努力维持生计的贫困青年来说，能够获得贷款十分重要。
column5: access to credit|n. 获得贷款的机会
column8: fulfil economic needs|满足经济上的需要

column1: The provision of small loans to support the entrepreneurial dreams and ambitions of youth can be an effective means to help them change their lives.
column2: 提供小额贷款以支持年轻人的创业梦想和抱负，可以成为帮助他们改变生活的有效手段。

column1: However, we believe that credit must be extended in association with other types of support that help participants develop critical life skills as well as productive businesses.
column2: 然而，我们认为，在提供信贷支持的同时，还应结合其他形式的援助措施，以帮助参与者培养重要的生活技能以及建立有成效的企业。
